column1: # TVI-WO-1202a: each case's and mutant's wall time in seconds, the weight tools/tviburi-route plan packs shards by.
# Re-weighed from CI's own logs on main after TVI-WO-1305 (runs 45493309831, 45494954973, 45509971801: 646 items each,
# 15 shard jobs, six CPU models): an item's time is the gap from the previous item's last line to its own. Each shard's
# speed is its median item against the old weights, over the run's Intel Xeon 6975P-C shards; an item weighs the mean
# of its three times, each divided by its shard's speed. So every weight is at the 6975P-C's speed (1.00).
# Never the list of what runs: that is the tree's own (tests/spike.sh, tests/mutants.tsv); an item missing here
# weighs its kind's median and still runs. KIND<tab>ID<tab>SECONDS.
# TVI-WO-1305a: its new cases and mutants, from its own CI run 45520722511 (five shards, each item the gap from the previous
# item's last line, divided by its shard's speed against the rows above: 1.01-1.04); usart-idlehse and US65-US68 came after
# that run and weigh the mean of the measured ones, 6.3 s.
